svg.title: rEach and Teach: the work lifecycle
svg.desc: Eight stages from sync to receipt: sync, plan, build, check, qualify, consent, submit and receipt. Four of them exchange sealed or signed material with Teach, and failed qualifications climb an attempt ladder that ends with the instructors.
svg.text: One slice of one assignment, from the first sealed package to the signed receipt.
course server · private to the instructors
2nd failed try: a notice. 3rd: a hand goes up, and the student's yes is needed to go on.
10th: everything stops until an instructor replies. A pass resets it.
Offline the gate passes for 24 hours and submissions wait. Unfinished work can go in
as a partial; a document assignment skips plan, check and qualify.
